en-US.longDescription: In KSpaceDuel each of two possible players control a satellite spaceship orbiting the sun. As the game progresses players have to eliminate the opponent's spacecraft with bullets or mines.
en-US.name: kspaceduel

zh-CN.longDescription: 在 KSpaceDuel 中，每两名玩家控制太阳轨道上的卫星飞船。随着游戏的推进，玩家必须使用子弹或地雷消灭对手的太空飞船。
